cases.input: One group operates distinct models by industry.
A direct model adds a marketplace.
Organization identity is used as business-model identity.
A value proposition is treated as a priced offer.
A BusinessModelRelease supplies segments, channels, valuePropositions, valueMechanism, revenueLogic and costLogic.
cases.expect: The release is accepted as a complete value mechanism.
cases.violates: none (exercises: Revenue logic is not observed revenue.)

cases.input: A second business model cites a pinned ValueProposition revision of another business model by reference without copying it.
cases.expect: The citation is accepted; the proposition retains exactly one container.
cases.violates: none (exercises: Value propositions are release-owned children.)

cases.input: The business-model candidate references WM-ORG-001, WM-ECO-021 and WM-ECO-002 as party, offer and price referents.
cases.expect: All three entries are rejected; party, offer and price are declared-unallocated and carry target null.
cases.violates: Partner and resource identities remain external.

cases.input: A business-model successor release cites only an issued WM-REC-010 record with no rationale and no approval occurrence.
cases.expect: The release is rejected until WM-KNW-010 and WM-ACT-024 referents are cited.

cases.input: One value proposition is mastered simultaneously by two business models as a second master rather than a pinned citation.
cases.expect: The second mastership is rejected; a value proposition has exactly one container at a time.

cases.input: A business-model release records the recipient value-state stage sequence as one of its own mastered attributes.
cases.expect: The attribute is rejected; stage sequence is mastered by the Value Stream and referenced only.
cases.violates: Business Model remains distinct from organization.

cases.input: A business-model release omits revenueLogic and costLogic while claiming mechanism mastership.
cases.expect: The release is rejected; capture logic is required for a value mechanism.
cases.violates: Revenue logic is not observed revenue.
